LDED technique was used to prepare CoCrFe 0.5Ni1.5Nb0.2 HEA. The raw materials were high-purity (≥ 99.5%) Fe, Ni, Co, Cr, and Nb metal powders, which were mixed according to the proportion of the desired compositions

The parameters of the LDED process were as follows: the laser power was 1000 W, the scanning speed was 15 mm/s, the energy density calculated is 22.22 J/mm 2, the powder feeding rate was 4 g/min, and the protective gas was 99.999% high-purity argon.

but also facilitates the formation of the Laves phase during LDED processes, achieving precipitation strengthening and markedly improving tensile strength.

the alloys are subjected to three types of wear mechanisms, which are abrasive, adhesive, and oxidative wear, respectively. Abrasive wear is a common wear mechanism, in which the friction partner continuously cuts the alloy during the rotation process, thus generating a large number of abrasive particles.
